{{Quote|And in the front row: Nearside pole position; Mawhonic!|Fode|<ref name="TPM" />}}
'''Mawhonic''' was a [[Gran]] [[Gender|male]] from the [[planet]] [[Hok]] who found fame as a [[podracer]] [[pilot]], with his three [[eye]]s granting him an advantage over other [[racer]]s. Flying [[Mawhonic's Podracer|a]] [[GPE-3130 Podracer]], he participated in the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|race]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] in [[32 BBY]]. The Gran was considered a capable challenger to [[Sebulba]], a competing pilot who was the favorite to win. Prior to the race, Mawhonic bowed to the crowds in the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena]] and once it began his pole position on the front row of the starting grid gave him a great start.

He was able to trail just behind Sebulba at the head of the pack until the racers reached the [[Mushroom Mesa]] during the first lap. Here, Mawhonic took his focus off the track and instead shook his fist angrily at Sebulba when the other racer rammed him with his [[Sebulba's Podracer|vehicle]]. This gave Sebulba the opportunity he needed to force the Gran's vehicle into a cliff face where one of its [[ThrustMaster 9000 aerospike rocket engine|engines]] exploded against the wall, knocking Mawhonic out of the race.

==Biography==
===Pole position podracer===
{{Quote|Begin the race!|Jabba the Hutt begins the Boonta|translated=1|audio=Jabba-BeginRace.flac|<ref name="TPM" />}}
[[File:Mawhonic-DB.png|thumb|right|300px|Mawhonic was a typical Outer Rim podracer pilot who participated in the Boonta Eve Classic on Tatooine.]]
A middle-class<ref name="Gran DB">{{Databank|gran|Gran}}</ref> [[Gran]] from the [[planet]] [[Hok]],<ref name="CVD" /> Mawhonic was a typical [[podracer]] from the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. He bought and sold spare parts to [[Hutt]]s, but refused the [[currency]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] and lived outside its laws.<ref name="CEUE" /> In [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY]].</ref> he participated in the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|race]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. He was represented by a [[Color|green]] flag with yellow in the bottom right and top two corners and a black stylized cross above the bottom left.<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref> Having found fame as a podracer,<ref name="Gran DB" /> he was viewed by knowledgeable podracing fans as a capable challenger to [[Sebulba]], the [[racer]] who was favored to win the race.<ref name="Mawhonic" />

Using [[Mawhonic's Podracer|his]] green [[GPE-3130 Podracer]],<ref name="FC">{{ForceCollection|Mawhonic|star=1}}</ref> he was positioned in nearside pole position on the front row of the starting grid in the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena]] and stood by his vehicle while two Gran [[Technician|mechanics]] worked on it before the race. A [[human]] then carried Mawhonic's banner in a procession of the different competitor's flags passed across the starting line. When the race's announcer, [[Fodesinbeed Annodue]], called out Mawhonic's name, the Gran bowed before the audiences in the grand stands to a swell of cheering. Once the event's host, [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], ordered the race to begin, Mawhonic and the other [[racer]]s boarded their vehicles and started their [[Podracer engine|engines]] as their crews left the race track.<ref name="TPM" />

===First crash of the race===
[[File:Mawhonic2-TPM.png|thumb|left|300px|Mawhonic bowed before the crowds at Mos Espa Grand Arena.]]
Once Jabba sounded the starting gong, the racers left the starting line,<ref name="TPM" /> with Mawhonic's placement on the grid giving the Gran a great start and enabling him to initially place himself just behind the lead racer [[Sebulba]],<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> who had been positioned beside Mawhonic on the grid<ref name="TPM" /> and was favored to win the race.<ref name="Geektionary" /> Starting the [[Mos Espa podrace circuit|circuit]], racers past through the [[Waldo Grade]] before entering the [[Mushroom Mesa]],<ref name="CL 2016">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> where Sebubla rammed his vehicle into the side of Mawhonic's pod, causing the Gran to curse at the other racer in [[Huttese]] while shaking his fist.<ref name="TPM" />

Sebulba called out in response and then rammed Mawhonic again, forcing the Gran's vehicle into a cliff face. The podracer rebounded off the wall, but Sebulba closed in an drove Mawhonic into the wall a final time<ref name="TPM" /> as the Gran tried to avoid him,<ref name="FC" /> causing the GPE-3130's left engine to crash into the wall and explode. Mawhonic's [[repulsorpod]] remained attached to remains of the destroyed engine as it spun out of control while the second engine detached and continued on alone, dropping to the desert floor and breaking up as it tumbled along through the sand.<ref name="TPM" />

[[File:MawhonicExplosion-TPM.png|thumb|right|300px|Sebulba caused Mawhonic to crash in Mushroom Mesa.]]
Having wasted no time in eliminating his Gran rival during the first lap,<ref name="Mawhonic" /> Sebulba laughed at Mawhonic's crash, but ultimately crashed out of the race himself before the racer [[Anakin Skywalker]] claimed first place.<ref name="TPM" /> Overall, the Gran was the second racer to be knocked out of the race during the Boonta Eve, surpassing only the amateur pilot [[Ben Quadinaros]], who never left the starting grid.<ref name="CL 2016" /> Mawhonic was later mentioned in an [[Unidentified artist|artist's]] [[Unidentified artist's journal|journal]], which was restored, expanded, and displayed at the [[Graf Archive]]<ref name="Alien Archives">''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]''</ref> at some point after 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]].<ref name="Year">{{AlienArchiveJournalDate}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Mawhonic, a Gran podracer, has the advantage of being able to see more of the light spectrum then most of his opponents.|The description of Mawhonic in an artist's journal|<ref name="Alien Archives" />}}
[[File:MawhonicFistShake-TPM.png|thumb|left|300px|Mawhonic focused on his rival Sebulba rather then the circuit in Mushroom Mesa, costing him the race.]]
Mawhonic was one of Tatooine's best podracer pilots<ref name="FC" /> and dreamed of winning the Boonta Eve Classic, but his dreams were dashed when he focused on his competitors rather then the course itself in the Mushroom Mesa, which required total concentration from pilots as the shadows and harsh light could effect their depth perception.<ref name="CL 2016" /> Failing to take the necessary care when facing someone like Sebubla, the Gran flew his vehicle too close to a cliff face and gave his competitor the opportunity he needed to knock the Gran out of the race.<ref name="Geektionary" /> Mawhonic had pink skin and three<ref name="TPM" /> large,<ref name="Geektionary" /> black [[eye]]s,<ref name="TPM" /> with his tri-ocular vision proving useful for split-[[second]] timing during races.<ref name="CEUE" /> He was also granted an advantage by the fact that he could see more of the light spectrum than most of his opponents.<ref name="Alien Archives" /> The Gran [[Gender|male]] stood 1.22 [[meter]]s (four [[foot]]) tall.<ref name="CEUE" />

==Equipment==
While participating in the Boonta Eve Classic, Mawhonic wore a set of metallic gray [[armor]], with an his two [[stomach]]s proudly encased in a textured armor plate. The outfit also included wrist guards, shoulder guards, leg guards, and a purple and gray [[jumpsuit]] covered in netting beneath the armor.<ref name="CEUE" />

Built by [[Galactic Power Engineering]], Mawhonic's<ref name="Andor">{{SW|url=series/andor/andor-season-1-episode-10-episode-guide|text="One Way Out" Episode Guide | Andor}}</ref> GPE-3130 Podracer was an awkward-looking and relatively unpopular model built for speed and little else. It was affordable and a terror on open, high-speed tracks with long straightaways and broad, gentle curves, but it twin [[ThrustMaster 9000 aerospike rocket engine]]s used extremely volatile [[fuel]] that detonated at the slightest provocation, and between the power control curve of the engines and the vehicle's overall speed, it was extremely difficult to control, especially in sharp turns and tight spaces. The [[cockpit]] was also extremely uncomfortable with an unintuitive control layout that made important details like altitude and airspeed hard for the pilot to see.<ref name="EV">''[[Endless Vigil]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
===Filming===
[[File:Mawhonic_Conceptual_Insiders_Guide.png|thumb|right|200px|Early concept art by Jay Shuster depicted Mawhonic as a never before seen species.]]
Mawhonic first appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> He was portrayed by [[Mark Coulier]]<ref name="Tatooine Tango">{{SWArchive|url=episode-i/fun/snapshot/2001/02/snapshot20010214.html|series=Episode I Snapshot|text=Tatooine Tango}}</ref> and was the only alien podracer in the film to be portrayed by an actor in costume, with the others added as puppets or digital effects,<ref name="AEYNTK">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> although a low-resolution computer-generated model of Mawhonic was also created to be shown in the cockpit when the vehicle is seen racing. Mawhonic's podracer was also one of the only full-scale vehicles created for filming the starting grid sequence so that Coulier could sit in the reclining seat on top.<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> The starting grid scenes were filmed in [[Oung Jmel|Chott el Gharsa]], [[Tunisia]], between [[August 5]]-[[August|6]], [[1997]].<ref name="Archives">''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005]]''</ref>

In the film's deleted scenes, additional footage of Mawhonic shows him waving to the crowd from his repulsorpod as all of the racers start their engines. He can then be seen revving his engines shortly before the race begins.<ref name="Deleted">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]''</ref> Mawhonic's mask was created by special effects artist [[Nick Dudman]] and his crew,<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|mawhonic|Mawhonic}}</ref> who built the mask based on the Gran mask created for the character [[Ree-Yees]] who appeared in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Chronicles" /> Dudman's team used techniques used to create the original mask,<ref name="DB" /> but also updated it with state-of-the-art radio-controlled animatronics to allow the character to be as expressive as possible for close ups.<ref name="Chronicles" /> The mask itself was redesigned by artist [[Howard Swindell]] and was also reused for a Gran [[senator]].<ref name="HowardSwindellInstagram">{{Instagram|username=howard.swindell|url=p/BtHEkKalYYm|name=[[Howard Swindell]]|date=2019-01-26|quote=Some more Phamtom Menace pics,I redesigned the Ree Yees character to be used as Pod Racer pilot and a senate leader,good times !. #starwars #monster #creature #fxmakeup #sculpting|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/8bC7U|archivefile=File:Granmaskswindell.jpg}}</ref> Multiple Gran masks were made for the film, with several others being used for the members of Mawhonic's pit crew.<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|mawhonic|Mawhonic}}</ref> One of the fabrics used in Mawhonic's costume was developed by a textile student who used latex and pebbles that she had hand-picked from the [[Wikipedia:England|English]] seashore. As the character's scenes were filmed in the [[Wikipedia:Tunisia|Tunisian]] desert during the hottest period of summer, the pebbles would pop out of the costume at increasingly dangerous speeds as the fabric heated up under the sun.<ref name="Costumes">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref>

Mawhonic of Hok was introduced to the film's script as early as the revised rough draft, but early conceptual art of the character depicted him as a new multi-eyed species, with [[Terryl Whitlatch]] creating a piece on [[August 23]], [[1996]], and [[Jay Shuster]] creating pieces on [[September 12]] and [[September 19|19]], 1996.<ref name="Insider's Guide">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> This design for the character was used in both the story boards and animatics of the film before being replaced with the Gran design.<ref name="TPMDVD">{{Film|I}} [[Star Wars home video releases|"Podrace Lap One - Animatics Split Screen" featurette]]</ref> Later art depicted Mawhonic as a thin Gran.<ref name="Insider's Guide">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> Mawhonic's final design was far more corpulent,<ref name="TPM" /> along with how Gran were portrayed in general throughout the [[Prequel trilogy]].<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref><ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref> The [[2016]] reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] erroneously uses<ref name="CL 2016" /> the flag of Ben Quadinaros<ref name="CVD" /> for Mawhonic, while assigning<ref name="CL 2016" /> the Gran's flag<ref name="CVD" /> to the racer [[Ratts Tyerell]].<ref name="CL 2016" />

===LEGO Shows===
{{Quote|[…]Mawhonic in his mean, green machine[…]|Fode introduces Mawhonic in "Exit from Endor"|<ref name="EfE">{{DroidTales|Exit from Endor}}</ref>}}
Mawhonic features in the non-[[canon]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures]]'' episode "[[Race on Tatooine]],"<ref name="RoT">{{FreemakerAdventures|Race on Tatooine}}</ref> which aired on [[July 18]], 2016.<ref name="RoTDate">{{YouTube|video=MJnc0s0xt4E|text=Race on Tatooine|channel=show/SC7GMxdyD28jjHoiECG7tOpQ?season=1|name=LEGO Star Wars: The Freemaker Adventures}}</ref> In the episode, he is depicted as taking part in the [[29th Annual Bricklayers' Classic]] podrace on Tatooine. During the second lap of the race, the [[bounty hunter]] [[Dengar]] comes up behind Mawhonic's pod in the stolen [[IPG-X1131 LongTail]] of [[Teemto Pagalies]] and then leaps out onto the back of the Gran's repulsor pod. From there, Dengar leaps to the engine of another pod and then continues to leap between vehicles in pursuit of the [[Freemakers/LEGO|Freemakers]], a family also competing in the race. During the pursuit, Dengar leaps on and off Mawhonic's pod again, surprising the Gran, before reaching his target; however, the Freemakers are ultimately able to win the race.<ref name="RoT" />

[[File:MawhonicSkywalker-EFE.png|thumb|right|300px|Mawhonic appeared in "Exit from Endor."]]
Mawhonic also appears in "[[Exit from Endor]]," the first episode of ''[[LEGO Star Wars: Droid Tales]]'',<ref name="EfE" /> which aired on [[July 6]], [[2015]].<ref name="EfEDate">{{YouTube|video=SGjoPgopLtA|text=Exit from Endor|channel=show/SCkNhajeNrARRe7MtuN5T36Q?season=1|name=LEGO Star Wars: Droid Tales}}</ref>. The episode is a non-canon retelling of the events of ''The Phantom Menace'' and depicts Mawhonic as surviving into the second lap of the Boonta Eve Classic just behind Sebulba. Skywalker then catches up to the Gran, who rams his engines into [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer|podracer]]; however, Skywalker then swings his engines back and sends Mawhonic spiralling into the sky where the Gran gives<ref name="EfE" /> a [[Wilhelm scream]]<ref name="RadioTimes">{{WebCite|url=http://www.radiotimes.com/news/film/2018-02-22/a-long-running-star-wars-tradition-has-been-put-to-rest|text=A long-running Star Wars tradition has been put to rest|author=Ling, Thomas|date=2018-02-22|archivedate=20180602044947}}</ref> before the podracer explodes. Parts of the vehicle then land in the sand around a sun-bathing [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="EfE" />

===Skywalker Saga===
{{Quote|That rotten cheat Sebulba, see! Every time we race he seems to find a way to bash my poor pod to smithereens, see! No matter how many times I rebuild, the old girl just falls apart again… What I need is a sturdier material to build from! Something like that super tough bone they have on Utapau. But how's an ordinary schlub supposed to get his hands, see, on such rarities?|Mawhonic in ''LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga''|<ref name="SkywalkerSaga">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]''</ref>}}
[[File:LEGOMawhonic-SWS.png|thumb|left|250px|Mawhonic is a playable character in ''LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga''.]]
In the [[2022]] non-canon [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'', Mawhonic participates in the Boonta Eve Classic as in the film, but crashes before even reaching the Mushroom Mesa. He can then be found by players in the streets of Mos Espa and will give them the mission "Pod Parts Procurement." He complains that Sebulba always manages to destroy his podracer when they compete and asks the player to retrieve some of the super tough [[bone]] found on the planet [[Utapau]] for him to build a new vehicle with. In [[Pau City]] on Utapau the players then collects three bone fragments that have fallen from the city's<ref name="SkywalkerSaga" /> [[ossic architecture]].<ref name="CL 2016" />

The fragments are more brittle than most bone found on the planet, but Mawhonic thanks the player for them when they return to him and tells them to look out for his new bone pod in the next Boonta Eve Classic. While trying to think of names for the new vehicle he suggests "Skele-torque" and "Rib-osine," although he rejects the first as terrible.<ref name="SkywalkerSaga" />

Once the quest is completed, Mawhonic is unlocked for purchase as a playable character. The character's in-game description lists Mawhonic as dynamic, but without the capabilities to beat Sebubla and describes his podracer as having an uncovered pod for greater visibility. In the game, Mawhonic ends many sentences with "see" when speaking.<ref name="SkywalkerSaga" />
